THE CORE IDEA

runs.text: Consumer surplus is the difference between a buyer's willingness to pay and the price actually paid. Surplus analysis compares value created with the opportunity cost of the resources used. Demand can be interpreted as buyers' marginal willingness to pay. The gain from an additional trade is the buyer’s willingness to pay minus the seller’s cost, not either side’s individual surplus alone.
